question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**alone**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence discusses the scenario of someone living alone and emphasizes that it does not mean they have to cook or eat by themselves.
 
• The appropriate word should reflect the idea of being by oneself, making "alone" the most suitable option.
 
• "**Alone**" fits well as it directly contrasts with the suggestion of inviting someone over for a meal.
 
• Other options ("**together**", "**healthy**", "**every day**") do not fit the context of describing the situation of living alone and eating by oneself.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Together (साथ में): "Together" means being with others, which contradicts the context of living alone.
 
• Healthy (स्वस्थ): "Healthy" refers to well-being and does not relate to the concept of eating alone.
 
• Every day (हर दिन): "Every day" refers to frequency and does not fit the context of discussing eating alone.
